saved_state_boundary.conditional_conclusion: A successful marker-path inspect establishes saved state. Subsequent stage resumes the same ID if that private saved state remains intact between commands. There can be two stage commands but one draft creation. Missing/unknown state blocks retry and requires reconciliation; deletion or concurrent mutation of private state is outside the conclusion.
